title: Women singers who sang like horns
summary: Billie Holiday, Ella, Sarah and Carmen sang like they were playing horns and loved musicians.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: Your mentioning her reminds me of something else, somewhat different from the tack

we started on, but just the other day you said something to the effect that "It was the women that carried us through there for a while." You named Ella and Sarah Vaughan and whatever. You said, "The musicians kind of fell down there for a while."

Well, what the singers were doin', they were singing a song, but they were singing with a jazz...they were singing like they were playin' a horn. That's the way Billy Holiday sang and Ella sang and Sarah. They sing like they playin' a horn. But the were usin' words, you see. But it has a jazz feeling, you know what I mean. But they were singing words. But those singers, they love musicians, you know, Sarah, Ella and Billy and Carmen, they love musicians. And they were truly jazz singers, because they sound like a horn.
